mapper.select: SELECT id, file_id, chunk_index, content, content_length, create_time, update_time FROM knowledge_chunk WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY chunk_index

SELECT c.id AS chunkId, c.file_id AS fileId, c.content AS content, MATCH(c.content) AGAINST (#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS score FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_file f ON c.file_id = f.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND MATCH(c.content) AGAINST (#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) > 0 ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
